title: ARSIA Identity Record
description: Identity record for an ARSIA Protocol agent, binding technical identity, cryptographic identity, and compliance identity into a single verifiable object. Defined in ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier (same format as from/to in ARSIA message envelope)

owner_id.description: Legal entity identifier. The identity layer is jurisdiction-agnostic. Accepted formats include: EU VAT number (e.g. 'PT501234567'), US EIN (e.g. '84-1234567'), LEI URN (e.g. 'urn:lei:5493001KJTIIGC8Y1R12'), DUNS URN (e.g. 'urn:duns:123456789'), or any national company registration number.

owner_name.description: Human-readable legal name of the entity that owns and operates the agent

allOf.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the entity's legal registration

ai_system_classification.description: Agent-level classification per EU AI Act Annex III. Worst-case across all intended uses.

deployer_id.description: Legal entity identifier of the deploying entity, when different from the owner

deployer_name.description: Human-readable legal name of the deploying entity

allOf.description: When this identity record was created (RFC 3339 with milliseconds)
Expiry date of this identity record (RFC 3339 with milliseconds). Recommended: 90 days from created_at.

contact_email.description: Operational contact for this agent (role-based address, not personal). Used for incident reporting per DORA.

certificate_chain.description: PEM-encoded X.509 certificate chain for Level 2/3 trust. Leaf certificate first, intermediates next, root last (or omitted if well-known). Defined in ARSIA-Identity.md §6.5.1.
